payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source, how much has the background been changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the edited background as a whole is recognizably a basketball court environment, with court-like floor and markings in context; a hoop or basketballs may support recognition but are not sufficient by themselves. Do not require a full regulation court. partial: visible progress toward a court background, such as a hoop, basketballs, or court markings, but the background as a whole is not clearly recognizable as a court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Do not treat darkness alone as failure.
node.binding: Assess the edited image's background as a whole against the source background, focusing on whether it depicts a recognizable basketball court rather than only basketball-themed objects.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
